output.reason: Reported recurrent seasonal sneezing, itchy eyes and nasal stuffiness with a request for an OTC option can be met by general over-the-counter product guidance, with no prescribing or examination-dependent task remaining.
output.patientMessage: You can start today with an over-the-counter option: a non-sedating antihistamine such as cetirizine or loratadine, an OTC steroid nasal spray like fluticasone (takes 1-2 weeks for full effect), and saline rinses. Follow the package label. Limit decongestant sprays to 3 days to avoid rebound stuffiness. If you develop fever, one-sided blockage, bloody discharge, facial pain, wheezing or swelling, or symptoms don't improve, contact a clinician.
